# needle CAT transcript v1
#
# Hand-written seed for MockTransport, using response shapes captured verbatim
# from a real FT-891 on 20m. Task 6 replaces this with a genuine
# RecordingTransport capture taken while spinning the VFO knob.
#
# The SM0; series deliberately includes the bogus 000 readings the radio emits
# during VFO motion, so --mock exercises SMeterDebouncer rather than pretending
# the quirk does not exist.
0 TX ID;
11 RX ID0650;
20 TX IF;
36 RX IF001014074000+000000200000;
50 TX SM0;
61 RX SM0047;
70 TX SM0;
81 RX SM0052;
90 TX SM0;
101 RX SM0000;
110 TX SM0;
121 RX SM0061;
130 TX SM0;
141 RX SM0000;
